The '''''Madman's Fortune''''' was a [[Museum/Legends|museum]] exhibit [[Starship/Legends|ship]] that flew as part of a traveling freak show. The ship was owned by the [[Snivvian/Legends|Snivvian]] [[Goontirk]] and at some point during [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history, Goontirk purchased the mummified remains of [[Vardovin IV]], the "Lost [[King/Legends|King]] of [[Duro/Legends|Duro]]" from a [[Ryn/Legends|Ryn]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], to display aboard the ''Madman's Fortune''. However, unknown to Goontirk, the mummy contained more than a dozen [[skekfish]] eggs and while the ''Madman's Fortune'' was passing through the [[Engebo system/Legends|Engebo system]], the mummy's [[Plasteel/Legends|plasteel]] coffin cracked open and the skekfish eggs hatched. The creatures attacked Goontirk and in an attempt to escape from them, he ran into one of the ship's [[Escape pod/Legends|escape pods]]. The skekfish pursued the Snivvian in and they devoured him before he could launch the pod, and thirty seconds later the ''Madman''{{'s}} automated safety systems launched the escape pod into the atmosphere of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Engebo V]].
